name: ARIOVISTUS
label: BERLIN RECORDS

photo.alt: ARIOVISTUS behind the decks, lit by a cyan neon ring

lede: ARIOVISTUS co-founded Berlin Records and built OUTKZT into a global, nomadic techno movement rooted in freedom over comfort.

bio.short: Born in Montreal in the early 1990s, ARIOVISTUS came of age as music shifted from analog to digital and techno and trance broke into the mainstream. Raised on a soundscape spanning Linkin Park, Daft Punk, Martin Garrix, and Illenium, he didn't pick up production and DJing until his late twenties, but once techno found him, it stuck.
